title: Ambient Realization Kernel, Algebraic-Power Independence, and Zeta-Bridge Firewall

evaluation_map.support_translation_invariance: sum a_j tau^(K_j) = 0 <=> sum a_j tau^(K_j - K_0) = 0

support_rank.definition: r(S) = dim_Q span_Q { K_j - K_0 } for finite support S = {K_1, ..., K_m}
support_rank.base_grade_independence: Proved; coordinate shifts between base grades lie in the rational span

rank_one_classification.condition: K_j - K_0 = q_j * alpha for alpha in A_R \ {0} and q_j in Q
rank_one_classification.exceptional_set: S_tau = { alpha in A_R : tau^alpha in Q_bar }
rank_one_classification.dichotomy_theorem: ev_tau is injective on Q_bar[Q*alpha] <=> alpha not in S_tau
rank_one_classification.explicit_witness_if_in_s_tau: [alpha] - A[0] where tau^alpha = A in Q_bar
rank_one_classification.gelfond_schneider_bound: dim_Q S_tau <= 1 (at most one rational line in A_R can be non-injective)

higher_rank_reduction.basis: alpha_1, ..., alpha_r in A_R Q-linearly independent
higher_rank_reduction.reduction_theorem: Finite support kernel relations of rational rank r are precisely multivariate algebraic-dependence relations Q(X_1, ..., X_r) = 0 for X_l = tau^(alpha_l / D)
higher_rank_reduction.algebraic_independence_equivalence: ev_tau is injective on Q_bar[Q*alpha_1 + ... + Q*alpha_r] <=> {tau^(alpha_1), ..., tau^(alpha_r)} are algebraically independent over Q_bar
higher_rank_reduction.transcendence_degree_equality: trdeg_Qbar Q_bar(X_1, ..., X_r) = trdeg_Qbar Q_bar(tau^(alpha_1), ..., tau^(alpha_r)) via finite algebraic field extension of degree <= D^r

minimal_open_case.target_problem: Does there exist any non-zero P in Q_bar[X, Y] such that P((2*pi)^sqrt(2), (2*pi)^sqrt(3)) = 0?

literature_theorem_matrix.kernel_consequence: tau = 2*pi is transcendental; base grade 1 in A_R is algebraic, while tau^1 = 2*pi is transcendental (1 not in S_tau)

literature_theorem_matrix.hypotheses: beta_1, ..., beta_n in Q_bar Q-linearly independent
literature_theorem_matrix.kernel_consequence: Fails because log(2*pi) is not proved algebraic; exponents alpha_j * log(2*pi) are not in Q_bar

literature_theorem_matrix.hypotheses: a in Q_bar \ {0, 1}, b in Q_bar \ Q
literature_theorem_matrix.kernel_consequence: Fails directly because base 2*pi is transcendental; applies only to quotients of S_tau, giving dim_Q S_tau <= 1

literature_theorem_matrix.proves: At least one of 6 exponentials is transcendental
literature_theorem_matrix.kernel_consequence: Vacuous for (1, log tau) x (alpha_1, alpha_2, alpha_3) because e^(alpha_j) is already transcendental by Lindemann

literature_theorem_matrix.proves: At least one of 4 exponentials is transcendental
literature_theorem_matrix.kernel_consequence: Vacuous for identical reason: e^(alpha_1), e^(alpha_2) are already transcendental

literature_theorem_matrix.hypotheses: Linear forms in logarithms of algebraic numbers
literature_theorem_matrix.kernel_consequence: Does not apply because log(2*pi) is not the logarithm of an algebraic number
Two-case derivation proves trdeg_Qbar Q_bar(tau^(alpha_1), ..., tau^(alpha_r)) = r, implying full finite-rank injectivity of ev_tau on all algebraic supports

schanuel_consequence.theorem: Schanuel's conjecture implies full finite-rank injectivity of ev_tau
schanuel_consequence.case_a: 1, alpha_1, ..., alpha_r Q-independent => Schanuel on (i*pi, L, alpha_1*L, ..., alpha_r*L) gives trdeg >= r + 2 on r + 2 generators => trdeg_Qbar Q_bar(X_1, ..., X_r) = r
schanuel_consequence.case_b: 1 in span_Q {alpha_1, ..., alpha_r} => tau^D = prod X_j^n_j => i*pi in Q_bar(X_1, ..., X_r) => Schanuel on (i*pi, alpha_1*L, ..., alpha_r*L) forces r + 1 <= 1 + trdeg_Qbar Q_bar(X_1, ..., X_r) => trdeg_Qbar Q_bar(X_1, ..., X_r) = r

disallowed_entities: log p (prime log weight, PROVED_TRANSCENDENTAL by Lindemann 1882)
zeta(2n) (even special value, PROVED_TRANSCENDENTAL rational multiple of pi^(2n))
zeta(2n+1) (odd special values, ALGEBRAICITY_UNPROVED; irrational != transcendental)
Gamma(s) (Gamma evaluations, ALGEBRAICITY_UNPROVED at nontrivial points)
Dirichlet series / explicit formulas (infinite distributions, not finite support)
zeta_bridge_firewall.audit_finding: NO_ZETA_TO_KERNEL_BRIDGE_FOUND (audited familiar zeta candidates do not furnish proved algebraic coefficients and grades; not an unconditional nonexistence theorem)

reasons: Transcendence of gamma_1 would disqualify it from being an algebraic grade
Algebraicity of gamma_1 would not supply an algebraic relation among powers of 2*pi
Zeta explicit formula produces continuous distributions, not finite elements of Q_bar[A_R]

proved_paper_derivation: Full group algebra Q_bar[Q*alpha] injectivity on arbitrary finite support
Equality of Q-spans and vector space dimensions under base change
Two-case Schanuel conditional theorem proving trdeg = r and full finite-rank injectivity of ev_tau
